summary: Manage home media services through TsArr from OpenClaw. Use for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, qBittorrent, Seerr, and Jellyfin tasks such as checking health, inspecting queues and history, browsing libraries, searching, adding, editing, deleting items, viewing profiles, tags, and root folders, managing torrents, managing media requests, triggering library scans, reading watched state, checking active playback sessions, fixing missing or poor cover images, and checking TsArr configuration.
